etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Tamara is the Russian form of Tamar. Russian performers, including ballerinas Tamara Karsavina and Tamara Toumanova, helped introduce it to English-speaking audiences. This history concerns the international given name; it does not establish tamara as a Malay common word or explain the unidentified token in the supplied packet. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/tamara).
